high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a digital publication. The content discusses the concept of "building a team of rivals," which is drawn from a book by Doris Kearns Goodwin titled "Team of Rivals: The Political Genius of Abraham Lincoln." The text explains how President Abraham Lincoln included three men he had defeated in the Republican nomination for his cabinet. These men represented different political spectrums, ranging from conservative to moderate to radical.
